mcqs.label: MCQ — Single Correct
mcqs.hint: Four options, one right answer. The default question style.

mcqm.label: MCQ — Multiple Correct
mcqm.hint: Four options where any combination can be correct.

oneWord.label: One Word Answer
oneWord.hint: Learners type a short answer. Auto-graded by exact match.

longAnswer.label: Long Answer
longAnswer.hint: Open-ended writing prompts — manual evaluation by the teacher.

mcqOnly.label: Only MCQs (Single Correct)
mcqOnly.description: Classic objective set — fastest to grade, easiest for learners.

mcqTf.label: MCQs + True / False
mcqTf.description: Objective mix that adds quick recall checks alongside MCQs.

mcqOneword.label: MCQs + One Word
mcqOneword.description: Recognition + recall — learners pick and also type short answers.

mixedAll.label: Mixed Assessment (all types)
mixedAll.description: A balanced spread of MCQ, True/False, One Word, and Long Answer.

subjectiveObjective.label: Subjective + Objective Mix
subjectiveObjective.description: MCQs for recall, Long Answers for application. Manual grading needed.
